lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在石头上，声音比生前钝。
lines.en: My paws click on stone, duller than they used to be.

lines.zh: 项圈还在脖子上，颜色一点没变。
lines.en: The collar's still on my neck, exactly the same color.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但我不会再摔死了。
lines.en: I walk slower now, but I won't fall to my death again.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我闻过，是墓园的味道。
lines.en: I've smelled this corridor before; it smells like a graveyard.

lines.zh: 尾巴竖着，只是尖上有点僵硬。
lines.en: My tail is up, just a little stiff at the tip.

lines.zh: 别催，四条腿也不太听使唤。
lines.en: Don't rush me; my four legs don't quite obey.

lines.zh: 我记得这扇门，生前从这儿溜出去。
lines.en: I remember this door; I once slipped out through it.

lines.zh: 脚下的草不响，我好像变轻了。
lines.en: The grass doesn't rustle; I think I've gotten lighter.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里有鱼的味道。
lines.en: I hug the wall, where the smell of fish lingers.

lines.zh: 生前我能跳上屋檐，现在只能看。
lines.en: I used to reach the eaves; now I only look up.

lines.zh: 我的影子淡得像一层灰。
lines.en: My shadow is thin and pale, like a smear of ash.

lines.zh: 一步一步，我总能走到你身边。
lines.en: Step by step, I still find my way to you.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，毛掉了一撮。
lines.en: I lick a paw and a tuft of fur comes loose.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有呼噜声，听起来像漏水。
lines.en: Something purrs in my throat, like a leaking roof.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在我身上，暖不起来。
lines.en: The sun shines on me and warms nothing.

lines.zh: 我把项圈上的灰蹭干净了。
lines.en: I rubbed the dust off my collar.

lines.zh: 那只蝴蝶停在鼻尖，我懒得动。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my nose; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我记得你摸我下巴的手法。
lines.en: I remember exactly how you scratched my chin.

lines.zh: 九条命，我才用掉了一条。
lines.en: Nine lives, and I've only spent one.

lines.zh: 我盯着墙角，那里有只虫子在爬。
lines.en: I stare at the corner where a bug is crawling.

lines.zh: 熔岩烧不掉这东西，真奇怪。
lines.en: Lava can't burn this thing. Strange, isn't it?

lines.zh: 别关门，我不喜欢被关在里面。
lines.en: Don't shut the door; I hate being closed in.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，眼睛还是那个颜色。
lines.en: You look down at me with the same eyes as before.

lines.zh: 你手里是鱼吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that fish in your hand? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步里夹着一颗小石子。
lines.en: There's a pebble caught in your step.

lines.zh: 你也死了吗？看起来不像。
lines.en: Did you die too? You don't look like it.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，我够不到你的手。
lines.en: Kneel down; I can't reach your hand from here.

lines.zh: 你数过项圈上有几道划痕吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the scratches on my collar?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，只是不想眨眼。
lines.en: I'm staring because I'd rather not blink.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，和墓园不一样。
lines.en: You smell different from the graveyard.

lines.zh: 如果我蹭你，别嫌我凉。
lines.en: If I rub against you, don't mind the cold.

lines.zh: 你还留着我那个旧窝吗？
lines.en: Do you still keep my old basket?

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾了湿泥。
lines.en: There's wet soil on your boots.

lines.zh: 我抬头是因为你比老鼠好看。
lines.en: I look up because you're better than a rat.

lines.zh: 别拿金苹果在我眼前晃。
lines.en: Don't wave that golden apple in front of my face.

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字，我记得那个音。
lines.en: You said my name; I remember that sound.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是有点散。
lines.en: I don't hurt; I'm just coming apart.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，还能站住。
lines.en: I wobbled a bit. Still standing.

lines.zh: 我的项圈还在，别担心。
lines.en: My collar's still here. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 我听见自己身上咔了一下。
lines.en: I heard something click inside me.

lines.zh: 你又打我，我记性不太好。
lines.en: You hit me again; my memory isn't great.

lines.zh: 我退两步，再回来。
lines.en: I back off two steps, then return.

lines.zh: 血是黑的，别害怕。
lines.en: The blood is black. Don't be scared.

lines.zh: 我这身子已经死过一次了。
lines.en: This body has died once already.

lines.zh: 疼的感觉，来得比生前慢。
lines.en: The pain arrives slower than it used to.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，等这阵过去。
lines.en: I lie down and wait for it to pass.

lines.zh: 鱼的味道，从你口袋里飘出来。
lines.en: Fish. The smell drifts out of your pocket.

lines.zh: 我不追了，但我会盯着看。
lines.en: I won't chase it, but I will watch.

lines.zh: 生前我会为一条鱼翻跟头。
lines.en: Alive, I'd have flipped for a single fish.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水？那味道让我后退。
lines.en: Weakness potion? That smell makes me back away.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放下，我自己过去。
lines.en: Put the fish down; I'll come to it myself.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比我的腿快多了。
lines.en: My nose is much faster than my legs.

lines.zh: 别用项圈逗我，那不公平。
lines.en: Don't dangle my collar at me; that's unfair.

lines.zh: 金苹果太亮了，刺得我眼疼。
lines.en: The golden apple glows too bright; it stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我闻到鱼，也闻到药水。
lines.en: I smell fish, and I smell potion.

lines.zh: 让我闻一闻，不一定要吃。
lines.en: Let me just sniff it; I don't have to eat.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被你压在地上了。
lines.en: My tail is pinned under your boot.

lines.zh: 我撞到你腿上，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: I bump your leg like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 让一让，我的爪子收不回去。
lines.en: Move over; my claws won't retract.

lines.zh: 我身上有土，别拍我的背。
lines.en: I'm covered in dirt; don't pat my back.

lines.zh: 贴着你走，我才不会迷路。
lines.en: Walking against you, I won't lose my way.

lines.zh: 门槛太高，我卡了一下。
lines.en: The threshold's too high; I caught on it.

lines.zh: 你的铁甲硌得我难受。
lines.en: Your iron armor is uncomfortable to lean on.

lines.zh: 我不是故意绊你的。
lines.en: I didn't mean to trip you.

lines.zh: 给我留一条缝，我过得去。
lines.en: Leave me a gap; I can squeeze through.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我骨头硬了。
lines.en: A bump is fine; my bones are harder now.

lines.zh: 我没有同类了，只有这个项圈。
lines.en: I have no kin left, only this collar.

lines.zh: 墓园里没有别的猫回应我。
lines.en: No other cat answers me in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 我曾在围墙上对着月亮叫。
lines.en: I used to call at the moon from the wall.

lines.zh: 活着的东西怕我，我习惯了。
lines.en: Living things fear me; I've gotten used to it.

lines.zh: 你是我唯一还会靠近的活人。
lines.en: You're the only living soul I still come near.

lines.zh: 两只猫的呼噜，我只记得一半。
lines.en: Two cats purring; I only remember half the sound.

lines.zh: 别给我找伴，我认项圈不认猫。
lines.en: Don't find me a mate; I know collars, not cats.

lines.zh: 我的孩子们都埋在花园里。
lines.en: My kittens are all buried in the garden.

lines.zh: 复活之后，很多东西都不想追。
lines.en: Since coming back, I no longer chase much at all.

lines.zh: 我陪你坐着，这比什么都强。
lines.en: I'll sit with you; that beats everything else.

lines.zh: 我把鱼叼回来，放在你脚边。
lines.en: I carry the fish back and set it at your feet.

lines.zh: 项圈我自己叼着，别抢。
lines.en: I'll carry my own collar. Don't grab it.

lines.zh: 骨头太沉，我拖了一路。
lines.en: The bone was heavy; I dragged it the whole way.

lines.zh: 我捡东西的习惯还没忘。
lines.en: I haven't forgotten how to fetch.

lines.zh: 这根线头，我记得是你的。
lines.en: This thread; I remember it was yours.

lines.zh: 别的东西我都不要，只要鱼。
lines.en: I don't want anything else. Just fish.

lines.zh: 我咬着它，牙齿有点松。
lines.en: I'm holding it, though my teeth are loose.

lines.zh: 熔岩边的项圈，我捞回来了。
lines.en: I fished the collar back from the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 这个圆环，我会一直守着。
lines.en: This little ring; I'll guard it always.

lines.zh: 放在你的箱子里，别弄丢。
lines.en: Put it in your chest. Don't lose it.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸在动，我看见了。
lines.en: That zombie is moving. I see it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴先绷紧。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail going stiff first.

lines.zh: 老鼠的味道，从草堆里出来。
lines.en: A rat's smell, coming out of the hay.

lines.zh: 我不快了，但我会一直跟。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I keep following.

lines.zh: 那个村民在看我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That villager is staring at me. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不会收回去。
lines.en: My claws won't go back in.

lines.zh: 它跑不掉的，我闻得到。
lines.en: It can't escape; I have its scent.

lines.zh: 生前的我先扑，现在先看。
lines.en: Alive I pounced first; now I watch first.

lines.zh: 你背后有个绿色的东西。
lines.en: There's something green behind your back.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，别推我。
lines.en: I'm in front of you. Don't push me.

lines.zh: 目标动了，我也该动了。
lines.en: The target moved, so I should move too.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发绿光。
lines.en: My eyes glow green in the dark.

lines.zh: 这次我咬得比生前轻。
lines.en: This bite is gentler than the ones I used to give.

lines.zh: 它退后了，我知道我赢了。
lines.en: It stepped back; I know I've won.

lines.zh: 它转身背对我，这是个错误。
lines.en: It turned its back. That was a mistake.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，找露出的脚踝。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for an exposed ankle.

lines.zh: 它举起剑，我不闪。
lines.en: It raises a sword; I don't dodge.

lines.zh: 我的背弓起来，毛竖成刺。
lines.en: My back arches, fur standing up like spikes.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，这里交给我。
lines.en: Step back a little; leave this to me.

lines.zh: 它的护甲挡不住我的牙。
lines.en: Its armor won't stop my teeth.

lines.zh: 我等它先动，这样省力气。
lines.en: I let it move first; it saves my strength.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音，它听见了。
lines.en: It heard the sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 地上的影子动了，我也动。
lines.en: The shadow on the ground moved; so did I.

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，我看不见你。
lines.en: Don't stand behind me; I can't see you.

lines.zh: 它怕我眼睛的颜色。
lines.en: It's afraid of the color of my eyes.

lines.zh: 我记下了它落脚的位置。
lines.en: I've marked where it plants each foot.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓进泥里，稳住。
lines.en: My claws dig into mud for balance.

lines.zh: 只要它不转身，我就不动。
lines.en: As long as it doesn't turn, I stay still.

lines.zh: 它喘气的节奏乱了。
lines.en: The rhythm of its breathing broke.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩了一下，它没看见。
lines.en: My tail flicked. It didn't see.

lines.zh: 它靠墙站着，我就贴地过去。
lines.en: It stands by the wall, so I crawl low.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处亮着，它慌了。
lines.en: My eyes glow in the dark and it panics.

lines.zh: 我咬过一次它的靴子，记住了。
lines.en: I bit its boot once. I remember where.

lines.zh: 我抓了它的小腿，抓痕发黑。
lines.en: I rake its shin; the scratches darken.

lines.zh: 咬下去的时候，我的牙有点钝。
lines.en: When I bite down, my teeth feel dull.

lines.zh: 这一下比生前轻，但够用。
lines.en: This blow is lighter than before, but enough.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，落地时歪了一下。
lines.en: I leap, and land slightly crooked.

lines.zh: 它把我甩开，我又贴上去。
lines.en: It throws me off; I come right back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子留在它衣服上了。
lines.en: My claws stayed in its clothes.

lines.zh: 血的味道，让我想起鱼。
lines.en: The smell of blood reminds me of fish.

lines.zh: 我咬住了就不打算松口。
lines.en: Once I bite, I don't plan to let go.

lines.zh: 换手，我从另一侧再抓。
lines.en: Switch sides; I rake from the other flank.

lines.zh: 别帮我，我自己能收尾。
lines.en: Don't help; I can finish this myself.

lines.zh: 我落地没声，它才回头。
lines.en: I landed silently; only then did it turn.

lines.zh: 这一爪比昨天准。
lines.en: That swipe was more accurate than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 我的前爪在抖，但没松。
lines.en: My foreleg shakes, but I don't let go.

lines.zh: 它倒下了，我坐着喘气。
lines.en: It fell; I sit beside it, catching my breath.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞它的膝盖。
lines.en: I slam into its knee from the side.

lines.zh: 爪子卡在它的皮带扣上。
lines.en: A claw snags on its belt buckle.

lines.zh: 项圈落在锚上，我从土里起来。
lines.en: The collar touched the anchor, and I rose from the soil.

lines.zh: 我又闻到墓园的湿土味了。
lines.en: I smell the wet graveyard soil again.

lines.zh: 我的毛里还夹着上次的泥土。
lines.en: There's still old dirt caught in my fur.

lines.zh: 别急着高兴，我不是原来的猫。
lines.en: Don't celebrate yet; I'm not the cat you knew.

lines.zh: 重生锚的光照得我眼睛发酸。
lines.en: The anchor's light makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我站起来，先抖了抖腿。
lines.en: I get up and shake out my legs first.

lines.zh: 项圈还在，我就还认得你。
lines.en: The collar's here, so I still know you.

lines.zh: 泥土下面很黑，也很安静。
lines.en: Under the dirt it was dark and very quiet.

lines.zh: 我听见你叫我，所以回来了。
lines.en: I heard you call me, so I came back.

lines.zh: 别用虚弱药水，我还不想变。
lines.en: Hold the weakness potion; I don't want to change yet.

lines.zh: 我第一脚碰到的是你的靴子。
lines.en: The first thing my paws touched was your boot.

lines.zh: 这一身皮肉不是我原来的。
lines.en: This hide and flesh aren't the ones I had.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我又欠你一条命。
lines.en: From today, I owe you another life.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，像从梦里爬出。
lines.en: I rise slowly, like crawling out of a dream.

lines.zh: 火不怕我，也烧不坏项圈。
lines.en: Fire doesn't frighten me, and it can't burn my collar.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，骨头没断。
lines.en: I fell from a height; nothing broke.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我不会沉。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I don't sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到墓碑上。
lines.en: The blast flung me onto a headstone.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在背上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back and won't come out.

lines.zh: 法术的光让我的毛立起来。
lines.en: The spell's light makes my fur stand up.

lines.zh: 饿这种感觉，我已经忘了。
lines.en: I've forgotten what hunger even feels like.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，只剩焦味。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; only a scorched smell remains.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，很安静。
lines.en: There's nothing below. It's very quiet.
